description_blocks.text: This kit is specifically designed for creators who love making motorized models. It includes 030 DC motors, reduction gear kits, power distribution board set, battery spring contact plate, and Y type wire, making it an ideal power and drive system for your motorized models.

Compact and Powerful motor: The 030 motor strikes a balance between the N20 motor and TT motor in terms of size and power. It can be used independently or paired with a gearbox. When combined with a gearbox, it offers lower costs compared to the N20 series and smaller size and more flexible control options compared to TT motors. When used alone, it can directly drive 3D-printed propellers, eccentric wheels, and other components.

Diverse Gear Ratios: The kit includes four gear ratios and single/dual-shaft output options, allowing for various output shaft speeds at the same power level. This caters to different speed requirements for various models, such as slow-speed, high-torque escalator models or high-speed, low-torque vehicle models. 3D printable gearbox housing models and assembly instructions are also provided.

Flexible Control: Equipped with a PDB set and Y type wire, it can connect to distribution boards, push-button switches, or rotary switches via SH1.0 connectors, enabling diverse and multi-channel control.
Dual Power Supply: Supports both USB and AAA battery power supply, catering to models that require long-term power or those that need to be free from power cords.

description_html:
Documentation


3D Model Application Instruction

 

Overview


This kit is specifically designed for creators who love making motorized models. It includes 030 DC motors, reduction gear kits, power distribution board set, battery spring contact plate, and Y type wire, making it an ideal power and drive system for your motorized models.



Key Features:

  • Compact and Powerful motor: The 030 motor strikes a balance between the N20 motor and TT motor in terms of size and power. It can be used independently or paired with a gearbox. When combined with a gearbox, it offers lower costs compared to the N20 series and smaller size and more flexible control options compared to TT motors. When used alone, it can directly drive 3D-printed propellers, eccentric wheels, and other components.
  • Diverse Gear Ratios: The kit includes four gear ratios and single/dual-shaft output options, allowing for various output shaft speeds at the same power level. This caters to different speed requirements for various models, such as slow-speed, high-torque escalator models or high-speed, low-torque vehicle models. 3D printable gearbox housing models and assembly instructions are also provided.
  • Flexible Control: Equipped with a PDB set and Y type wire, it can connect to distribution boards, push-button switches, or rotary switches via SH1.0 connectors, enabling diverse and multi-channel control.
  • Dual Power Supply: Supports both USB and AAA battery power supply, catering to models that require long-term power or those that need to be free from power cords.

Applications:

  • Train models
  • Rotating display stand
  • Escalator models
  • Fans
